question: How many gold medals did India win in Wrestling at the Birmingham 2022 CWG?
solution:
The correct answer is __**6**__

**__Key Points__**
__

• India's wrestling contingent delivered an exceptional performance at the **Birmingham 2022 Commonwealth Games**, winning a total of **12 medals** across various weight categories.

• Out of the 12 medals won in wrestling, **6 were gold medals**, 1 was silver, and 5 were bronze.

• The **six gold medalists** who brought glory to India in wrestling were:
 
 
• **Bajrang Punia**: Men's Freestyle 65kg
 
• **Sakshi Malik**: Women's Freestyle 62kg
 
• **Deepak Punia**: Men's Freestyle 86kg
 
• **Ravi Kumar Dahiya**: Men's Freestyle 57kg
 
• **Vinesh Phogat**: Women's Freestyle 53kg
 
• **Naveen Malik**: Men's Freestyle 74kg
 

• Wrestling was the **most successful sport** for India at the 2022 Games, with every single member of the 12-member wrestling squad winning a medal.

**Additional Information__**

• The **Birmingham 2022 Commonwealth Games** (officially known as the XXII Commonwealth Games) were held in **England**, United Kingdom.

• India finished in **fourth position** in the overall medal tally, securing a total of **61 medals** (22 Gold, 16 Silver, and 23 Bronze).

• **Vinesh Phogat** achieved a historic feat by becoming the first Indian woman to win **three consecutive gold medals** at the Commonwealth Games (Glasgow 2014, Gold Coast 2018, and Birmingham 2022).

• The lone **silver medal** in wrestling was won by **Anshu Malik** in the Women's Freestyle 57kg category.

• The **bronze medalists** in wrestling included **Divya Kakran**, **Mohit Grewal**, **Pooja Gehlot**, **Pooja Sihag**, and **Deepak Nehra**.
